name: Basic salary
authority: Employment Act 1968 s.20A: salary for an incomplete month is the monthly gross rate × the working days served ÷ the working days in the month (its planned WORK days; calendar days when no schedule is planned).

name: Overtime (1.5×)
authority: Employment Act 1968 s.38(4): overtime at not less than 1.5 times the hourly basic rate; s.38(5) and the Fourth Schedule hourly basic rate = 12 × monthly basic ÷ (52 × 44). For a non-workman earning above SGD 2,250 the overtime rate is computed on SGD 2,250 (MOM, Hours of work and overtime).

name: Incentive hours (1.5×)
authority: Employment Act 1968 s.38(4): overtime at not less than 1.5 times the hourly basic rate; s.38(5) and the Fourth Schedule hourly basic rate = 12 × monthly basic ÷ (52 × 44). For a non-workman earning above SGD 2,250 the overtime rate is computed on SGD 2,250 (MOM, Hours of work and overtime).

name: No-pay leave
authority: Employment Act 1968 s.20A: a day of no-pay leave reduces the month’s salary by the monthly rate ÷ the working days in the month (calendar days when no schedule is planned).
quantity: sum(leave.rows.filter(r, r.activity == "TIME_OFF").map(r, r.is_npl ? r.days : r.days * (1.0 - r.pay_fraction)))

name: Leave encashment
authority: Employment Act 1968 s.88A(8): an employee dismissed other than for misconduct is paid for untaken annual leave; Employment Act s.20A: a day's pay is the monthly rate divided by the working days in the month (calendar days when no schedule is planned). The tap records the days; this line pays them.

name: Public holiday work (extra day’s basic pay)
authority: Employment Act 1968 s.88(4)–(4A): an employee who works on a public holiday at the employer’s request is paid, besides the gross rate for the day, an extra day’s salary at the basic rate of pay (MOM, Public holidays: entitlement and pay, https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/public-holidays-entitlement-and-pay). MOM, Monthly and daily salary (https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/salary/monthly-and-daily-salary): the daily basic rate is 12 × monthly basic ÷ (52 × the average days the employee is required to work a week). A roster day on a published public or substitute holiday is the work; time off in lieu by agreement is not priced. Part-time employees are paid under the Part-Time Regulations and are not priced here. s.88(4A): an employee outside Part 4 (not a s.35 workman or s.35(b) employee) may instead be given a day off, or part of one, in lieu of the extra day’s salary; record such time off and void the line rather than paying both.
eligibility: employment.classification != "NON_EA" && terms.employment_type != "PART_TIME" && has(employee.facts.working_days_per_week) && work.holidays.exists(h, (h.kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE"] && (h.given_to != "ONLY_IF_OFF_ON_REPLACED_DATE" || (h.replaces != "" && !(h.replaces in work.dates)))))

name: Rest-day work (EA s.37)
authority: Employment Act 1968 s.37(2)–(3) (AGC, read 2026-10-07): a Part 4 employee who works on a rest day at his or her own request is paid half a day’s basic rate for up to half the normal hours, one day’s for more; at the employer’s request one day’s for up to half the normal hours, two days’ for more. Hours beyond the normal hours are overtime (s.37(2)(c)/(3)(c)) and priced by OVERTIME from the approved hours. Daily basic rate per MOM: 12 × monthly basic ÷ (52 × days worked a week). Customer input: employee.facts.rest_day_work_requester (EMPLOYER | EMPLOYEE), normal_daily_hours, working_days_per_week.
quantity: sum(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "REST" && d.worked_hours > 0.0).map(d, employee.facts.rest_day_work_requester == "EMPLOYEE" ? (d.worked_hours <= employee.facts.normal_daily_hours / 2.0 ? 0.5 : 1.0) : (d.worked_hours <= employee.facts.normal_daily_hours / 2.0 ? 1.0 : 2.0)))
eligibility: employment.classification != "NON_EA" && ((terms.statutory_work_category != "NON_MANUAL" && terms.base_salary <= 4500.0) || (terms.statutory_work_category == "NON_MANUAL" && terms.base_salary <= 2600.0)) && has(employee.facts.rest_day_work_requester) && has(employee.facts.normal_daily_hours) && has(employee.facts.working_days_per_week) && size(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "REST" && d.worked_hours > 0.0)) > 0

name: Part-time public holiday work
authority: Employment (Part-Time Employees) Regulations; MOM, Public holidays for part-time employees (https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/part-time-employment/public-holidays, read 2026-10-07): a part-timer required to work on a public holiday is paid, besides the holiday entitlement, the basic rate of pay for one day’s work — the day’s hours at the hourly basic rate 12 × monthly basic ÷ (52 × contracted weekly hours). Customer input: employee.facts.part_time_weekly_hours.
quantity: sum(work.days.filter(d, has(d.holiday_kind) && d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE"] && d.worked_hours > 0.0).map(d, d.scheduled_hours > 0.0 ? d.scheduled_hours : d.worked_hours))
eligibility: terms.employment_type == "PART_TIME" && has(employee.facts.part_time_weekly_hours) && size(work.days.filter(d, has(d.holiday_kind) && d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE"] && d.worked_hours > 0.0)) > 0
